title: Next-generation mucosal vaccines for respiratory viruses: Immunological rationale, technological advances, and clinical perspectives.
snippet: Respiratory viruses, including SARS-CoV-2, influenza, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), continue to impose a substantial global health burden. While currently licensed injectable vaccines effectively prevent severe disease, they are limited in inducing robust mucosal immunity at the primary sites of viral entry. title: Incomplete thermal ablation is associated with intrahepatic spread of hepatocellular carcinoma and the miR-450a-2-3p/PIK3CA pathway.
snippet: Incomplete thermal ablation contributes to the intrahepatic spread of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The function of miR-450a-2-3p in treatment response to incomplete thermal ablation of HCC is unknown, despite its known tumor‑suppressive function.
